Program recap

Execution program: backlog-review delivery

A sponsor-level view of the program map, the latest wave evidence, and the working agreements that shaped delivery.

Program overview

The program turned a reviewed plan corpus into coordinated delivery waves. Each wrapper kept lane work reviewable while fan-in checks guarded the shared release and skill surfaces.

Current state

Every composed wave has landed. One dispatch-baseline lane returned to planning because its proposed seam conflicted with a recorder guard.

Foundations, truthful contracts, then workflow containment.

W4 → W5

Delivered-project follow-ups and intake corrections.

W6 → W7

Truthfulness residue followed by corrective lanes.

Convention evolution

Prove claims at the source

Reviews increasingly required runnable probes and failure controls instead of inferred assurance.

Stop on a false premise

A bounded refresh handled local premise errors; architectural conflicts returned to planning.

Protect shared seams

Fan-in owners coordinated release versions, skill pins, and integration gates.
